title: அப்பாவின் பித்தளைக் கடை
narrative: கமலாவின் அப்பா மதுரை மீனாட்சி கோயில் அருகே பித்தளைப் பாத்திரக் கடை வைத்திருந்தார். பள்ளி முடிந்ததும் அவள் கடையில் உட்கார்ந்து பாத்திரங்களைப் புளி போட்டுத் துடைப்பாள்.
verbatim_quote: கடை முழுக்க புளி வாசனையும் பித்தளை மினுமினுப்பும்
en_narrative: Her father kept a brass-vessel shop near the Meenakshi temple in Madurai. After school she sat in the shop polishing the vessels with tamarind.

title: முற்றமும் ஊஞ்சலும்
narrative: அவள் வளர்ந்த வீட்டில் நடுவில் திறந்த முற்றம், ஒரு துளசி மாடம், கூடத்தில் மரத்தால் ஆன பெரிய ஊஞ்சல் இருந்தது. மாலையில் அம்மா ஊஞ்சலில் உட்கார்ந்து பாட்டுப் பாடுவார்.
verbatim_quote: அந்த ஊஞ்சல் சத்தம் இன்னும் காதில் கேட்குது
en_narrative: The house she grew up in had an open courtyard with a tulsi stand and a big wooden swing in the hall, where her mother sang in the evenings.

title: பாட்டியின் இரவுக் கதைகள்
narrative: அப்பாவின் அம்மா, பாட்டி, இரவில் மொட்டை மாடியில் நட்சத்திரங்களுக்குக் கீழே படுத்துக்கொண்டு ராமாயணக் கதைகள் சொல்வார். அனுமன் கதை வந்தால் குழந்தைகள் எல்லோரும் தூங்காமல் இருப்பார்கள்.
en_narrative: Her paternal grandmother told Ramayana stories at night on the terrace under the stars; the children stayed awake for the Hanuman parts.

title: என் கல்யாணம்
narrative: 1968-ல் கமலாவுக்கும் சுப்ரமணியனுக்கும் மதுரையில் அவர்கள் வீட்டிலேயே கல்யாணம் நடந்தது. மணமேடையில்தான் அவள் அவரை முதல் முறையாகச் சரியாகப் பார்த்தாள்; நாதஸ்வரம் விடிய விடிய வாசித்தது.
en_narrative: Kamala married Subramanian in 1968 at the family house in Madurai. She saw him properly for the first time on the wedding dais, and the nadaswaram played all night.

title: சரோஜா டீச்சர்
narrative: பள் ளிக் கூடத்தில் சரோசா டீச்சர் தான் முதன் முதலில் அவளுடைய குரலைக் கவனித்தார். பிரார்த்தனைக் கூட்டத்தில் தனியாகப் பாட வைத்தார், அது அவளுக்குத் தைரியம் கொடுத்தது.
en_narrative: At school Sarosa teacher was the first to notice her voice and had her sing alone at the prayer assembly, which gave her confidence.

title: Paattu class aarambam
narrative: Ennoda paattu class 8 vayasula start aachu. Every morning 5 manikku amma ezhuppi viduvanga, varnam practice pannanum, illana breakfast kidaiyaathu.
en_narrative: She began music lessons at eight. Her mother woke her at five every morning to practise varnams, and there was no breakfast until she had.

title: Chithirai festival on father's shoulders
narrative: During the Chithirai festival the streets around the temple were packed. Her father carried her on his shoulders so she could see the celestial wedding procession, and bought her a paper fan.
open_threads: what else they bought at the fair
en_narrative: During the Chithirai festival the streets around the temple were packed. Her father carried her on his shoulders so she could see the celestial wedding procession, and bought her a paper fan.

title: அம்மாவின் ஞாயிறு சமையல்
narrative: ஞாயிற்றுக்கிழமை அம்மா புளியோதரையும் தயிர் சாதமும் செய்வார். அம்மாவின் கையில் எப்போதும் புளியும் கறிவேப்பிலையும் மணக்கும்.
en_narrative: On Sundays her mother made puliyodharai and curd rice, and her mother's hands always smelled of tamarind and curry leaves.

title: Veetla music class
narrative: Kalyanam aana appuram Mylapore-la veetlaye neighbourhood ponnungalukku paattu solli kuduthen. Oru student-ku maasam 10 rupees, adhu ennoda first sambaadhyam.
en_narrative: After her marriage she taught singing to neighbourhood girls at home in Mylapore for ten rupees a month each, her first earnings.

title: எமர்ஜென்சி நாட்கள்
narrative: 1975 எமர்ஜென்சியின் போது கணவர் வங்கியில் வேலை செய்தார்; எல்லோரும் பயந்து பேசினார்கள். செய்தித்தாளில் வெற்றுக் கட்டங்கள் வந்தன, ரேடியோ செய்தியை மட்டும் கேட்டார்கள்.
en_narrative: During the 1975 Emergency her husband was working at the bank and everyone spoke in fear. Newspapers came with blank columns and they relied on the radio.

title: Chennai-ku vandhom
narrative: Kalyanam mudinjathum avarukku Madras transfer aachu. Mylapore-la oru chinna portion rent-ku eduthom, oru room, oru kitchen, common bathroom.
en_narrative: Right after the wedding her husband was transferred to Madras, and they rented a small portion in Mylapore with one room, a kitchen and a shared bathroom.

title: Lakshmi is born
narrative: Her daughter Lakshmi was born in 1971 at the government hospital in Egmore. Her mother came from Madurai by the night train with a basket of homemade sweets for the nurses.
open_threads: how the name Lakshmi was chosen
en_narrative: Her daughter Lakshmi was born in 1971 at the government hospital in Egmore. Her mother came from Madurai by the night train with a basket of homemade sweets for the nurses.

title: மார்கழி கோலப் போட்டி
narrative: 1980-ல் மயிலாப்பூர் மார்கழி விழாவில் நடந்த கோலப் போட்டியில் கமலா முதல் பரிசு வாங்கினாள். நூற்றியெட்டுப் புள்ளிக் கோலம், விடியற்காலை நான்கு மணிக்கே ஆரம்பித்தாள்.
en_narrative: In 1980 she won first prize in the kolam competition at the Mylapore Margazhi festival with a 108-dot design she started at four in the morning.

title: மாமியார் சொன்ன பொறுமை
narrative: மாமியார் அடிக்கடி சொல்வார்: பொறுமையாக இருந்தால் எல்லாம் சரியாகும். ஆரம்பத்தில் அது கஷ்டமாக இருந்தது, இப்போது அதையே பேத்திக்குச் சொல்கிறாள்.
en_narrative: Her mother-in-law often said that patience sets everything right. It was hard at first; now she says the same to her granddaughter.

title: Subbu's bank job
narrative: Her husband Subbramaniyan worked at Indiyan Bank for thirty two years, starting as a clerk and retiring as branch man ager in Triplicane. He walked to work every day with a steel tiffin box.
en_narrative: Her husband Subbramaniyan worked at Indiyan Bank for thirty two years, starting as a clerk and retiring as branch man ager in Triplicane. He walked to work every day with a steel tiffin box.

title: Pallanguzhi summer
narrative: Summer leave-la Melur pakkathula paati gramathukku poi cousins kooda pallanguzhi aaduvom. Puliyamuthu vechu, full day aatam, saapadu marandhuduvom.
en_narrative: In the summer holidays she went to her grandmother's village near Melur and played pallanguzhi with cousins all day using tamarind seeds.

title: பத்தாவதோடு நின்ற படிப்பு
narrative: எஸ்.எஸ்.எல்.சி முடிந்ததும் கல்யாணம் பேசி முடித்துவிட்டார்கள், அதனால் கல்லூரிக்குப் போக முடியவில்லை. அது இன்னும் ஒரு சின்ன வருத்தம்.
en_narrative: Her marriage was fixed right after her SSLC, so she could not go to college. It remains a small regret.

title: The 2015 floods
narrative: In the 2015 Chennai floods water entered the ground floor of their building. The neighbours all moved up to the terrace for three days and shared whatever rice and milk they had.
en_narrative: In the 2015 Chennai floods water entered the ground floor of their building. The neighbours all moved up to the terrace for three days and shared whatever rice and milk they had.

title: AIR audition
narrative: 1983-la All India Radio Madras-la audition kuduthen, select aagi oru thadavai live-a paadinen. Veetla ellarum radio pakkathula ukkandhu kettanga.
en_narrative: In 1983 she auditioned at All India Radio Madras, was selected and sang live once while the whole family listened by the radio.

title: ரவி அமெரிக்கா போனான்
narrative: மகன் ரவி 1975-ல் பிறந்தான்; 2001-ல் வேலைக்காக அமெரிக்கா போனான். அந்த நாட்களில் வாரம் ஒருமுறை STD பூத்திலிருந்து போன் வரும்.
en_narrative: Her son Ravi was born in 1975 and went to America for work in 2001. In those days he called once a week to an STD booth.

title: Nalla per mukkiyam
narrative: Pethi-kitta eppovum solluven: panatha vida nalla per thaan mukkiyam. Avanga thaatha-vum adhe maadhiri vaazhndhaar.
en_narrative: She always tells her granddaughter that a good name matters more than money, as her husband lived by.

title: நாற்பது மாணவிகள்
narrative: வீட்டில் ஆரம்பித்த சங்கீத வகுப்பு நாற்பது மாணவிகள் வரை வளர்ந்தது. 1990-ல் அவருடைய மாணவி ஒருத்தி முதல் முறையாக சபாவில் கச்சேரி செய்தாள்.
en_narrative: The music class she started at home grew to forty students, and in 1990 one of them gave her first concert at a sabha.

title: வைகையில் வெள்ளம்
narrative: பத்து வயதில் வை கை ஆற்றில் வெள்ளம் வந்தது; தெருவில் தண்ணீர் ஓடியது. அவளும் தம்பியும் காகிதக் கப்பல் விட்டார்கள், அம்மா திட்டினார்.
en_narrative: When she was ten the Vai gai river flooded and water ran down the street. She and her younger brother floated paper boats and their mother scolded them.

title: ஞாயிறு பில்டர் காபி
narrative: ஞாயிற்றுக்கிழமைகளில் மட்டும் கணவர் தானே பில்டர் காபி போட்டு அவளுக்குக் கொண்டு வருவார். அது அவர்களுடைய சின்ன சடங்கு.
en_narrative: Only on Sundays her husband made filter coffee himself and brought it to her; it was their small ritual.

title: MGR funeral
narrative: 1987-la MGR irandhappo Chennai fulla kadai ellam moodiyaachu. Lakhs of people road-la, naanga terrace-la irundhu paathom, ellarum azhudhanga.
en_narrative: When MGR died in 1987 every shop in Chennai shut. Lakhs of people filled the roads; they watched from the terrace and everyone wept.

title: Lakshmi-oda kalyanam
narrative: 1995-la ponnu Lakshmi-ku Mylapore kalyana mandapathula kalyanam. Ellame naane arrange panninen; caterer late-a vandhaan, naane kitchen-la poi sambar paathen.
en_narrative: Her daughter Lakshmi married in 1995 at a kalyana mandapam in Mylapore. Kamala arranged everything; the caterer came late and she went into the kitchen to check the sambar herself.

title: முதல் பேரக்குழந்தை
narrative: 1998-ல் லக்ஷ்மிக்கு முதல் குழந்தை பிறந்தது. கமலா மூன்று மாதம் பெங்களூரில் தங்கி மகளுக்கு உதவினாள்.
en_narrative: Lakshmi's first child was born in 1998, and Kamala stayed three months in Bangalore to help her daughter.

title: Jasmine on the terrace
narrative: She grows jasmine creepers on the terrace and strings the flowers every evening. The garlands go to the Amman temple at the end of the street.
en_narrative: She grows jasmine creepers on the terrace and strings the flowers every evening. The garlands go to the Amman temple at the end of the street.

title: தனியாக வாழக் கற்றது
narrative: 2012-ல் கணவர் இறந்த பிறகு தனியாக வாழக் கற்றுக்கொண்டாள். காலையில் தம்புராவை எடுத்து பாடுவதுதான் அவளைக் காப்பாற்றியது.
en_narrative: After her husband died in 2012 she learned to live alone. Singing with the tambura every morning is what saved her.

title: WhatsApp kathukitten
narrative: Pethi enakku Whats app solli kuduthaa. Ippo naane vois note anuppuren, video call-um panren.
en_narrative: Her granddaughter taught her Whats app; now she sends vois notes herself and makes video calls.

title: தீபாவளி கல்லாப்பெட்டி
narrative: தீபாவளி கூட்டத்தில் அப்பா அவளைக் கடையின் கல்லாப்பெட்டியைப் பார்த்துக்கொள்ளச் சொன்னார். பரிசாக ஒரு சின்ன பித்தளைக் குங்குமச் சிமிழ் கொடுத்தார்.
en_narrative: During the Deepavali rush her father let her mind the shop's cash box, and gave her a small brass kumkum box as a reward.

title: The temple cassette
narrative: In 2005 a temple trust asked her to record devotional songs. The cassette sold at the temple stall for years and she never took any money for it.
en_narrative: In 2005 a temple trust asked her to record devotional songs. The cassette sold at the temple stall for years and she never took any money for it.

title: Ravi-oda pasanga
narrative: Last year Ravi pasangala kootittu US-la irundhu vandhaan. Pasangalukku Tamil theriyaadhu, naan English-la kadhai solla try panninen.
en_narrative: Last year Ravi came from the US with his children. They do not speak Tamil, so she tried telling them stories in English.

title: டிசம்பர் சீசன்
narrative: டிசம்பர் சீ சன் வந்தால் டிவியில் கச் சேரி பார்ப்பது தான் அவளுக்குப் பிடித்த வேலை. இப்போது சபாவுக்குப் போக முடியவில்லை.
en_narrative: In the December music sea son her favourite thing is watching kach cheri concerts on TV, since she can no longer go to the sabhas.

title: Say it while you can
narrative: Her advice to the young: do not wait to tell people you love them. She says she told her husband too rarely.
en_narrative: Her advice to the young: do not wait to tell people you love them. She says she told her husband too rarely.

title: வெள்ளி விழா வீணை
narrative: 1993-ல் இருபத்தைந்தாவது திருமண நாளுக்குக் கணவர் அவளுக்கு ஒரு வீணை வாங்கிக் கொடுத்தார். அதை அவள் இன்னும் யாரையும் தொட விடுவதில்லை.
en_narrative: For their 25th wedding anniversary in 1993 her husband bought her a veena, which she still lets no one else touch.

title: Lakshmi-oda seemantham
narrative: 1997-la Lakshmi-ku seemantham Bangalore-la, naan valayal poduradhukku train-la ponen.
en_narrative: In 1997 she took the train to Bangalore for her daughter Lakshmi's seemantham and put the bangles on her herself.

title: Ennoda seemantham
narrative: 1970-la ennoda seemantham Madurai amma veetla nadandhuchu, amma neraiya valayal pottanga.
en_narrative: Her own seemantham was held in 1970 at her mother's house in Madurai, where her mother covered her arms in bangles.

title: Ravi-oda poonal
narrative: 1983-la Ravi-ku poonal pottom, Mylapore veetlaye. Mottai adichathukku avan romba azhudhaan.
en_narrative: In 1983 they held Ravi's sacred-thread ceremony at the Mylapore house; he cried a lot because his head was shaved.

title: Ravi-oda kalyanam
narrative: 2004-la Ravi US-la irundhu vandhu Chennai-la kalyanam pannikittaan, ponnu Bengali.
en_narrative: Her son Ravi came from the US in 2004 to marry in Chennai; the bride was Bengali.

title: തൃശ്ശൂരിലെ തറവാട്
narrative: സരോജിനി വളർന്നത് തൃശ്ശൂരിനടുത്തുള്ള ഒരു പഴയ തറവാട്ടിലാണ്. മുറ്റത്ത് വലിയൊരു മാവും പിന്നിൽ ഒരു കുളവും ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു.
en_narrative: Sarojini grew up in an old ancestral house near Thrissur, with a big mango tree in the yard and a pond behind it.

title: കണക്ക് മാഷായ അച്ഛൻ
narrative: അച്ഛൻ ഗ്രാമത്തിലെ സ്കൂളിൽ കണക്ക് മാഷായിരുന്നു. രാത്രി മണ്ണെണ്ണ വിളക്കിന്റെ വെളിച്ചത്തിൽ കുട്ടികളെ പഠിപ്പിക്കുമായിരുന്നു.
en_narrative: Her father taught mathematics at the village school and tutored children at night by a kerosene lamp.

title: എന്റെ കല്യാണം
narrative: 1963-ൽ ഗുരുവായൂർ അമ്പലത്തിൽ വെച്ചായിരുന്നു ഗോപാലനുമായുള്ള കല്യാണം. താലികെട്ട് കഴിഞ്ഞ് സദ്യ വീട്ടിൽ, ഇരുന്നൂറ് പേർ.
en_narrative: She married Gopalan in 1963 at the Guruvayur temple; the feast for two hundred guests was served at home.

title: ഗ്രാമത്തിൽ കറന്റ് വന്ന രാത്രി
narrative: 1960-ൽ ഗ്രാമത്തിൽ ആദ്യമായി വൈദ്യുതി വന്നു. അന്ന് രാത്രി എല്ലാവരും ആദ്യത്തെ ബൾബ് കത്തുന്നത് കാണാൻ വായനശാലയിൽ കൂടി.
en_narrative: Electricity reached her village in 1960, and that night everyone gathered at the reading room to watch the first bulb come on.

title: സ്കൂളിലേക്കുള്ള നടത്തം
narrative: ഇരിഞ്ഞാ ലക്കുട ഗേൾസ് ഹൈ സ്കൂളിൽ പത്താം ക്ലാസ് വരെ പഠിച്ചു. ദിവസവും നാല് കിലോമീറ്റർ നടന്നാണ് പോയിരുന്നത്.
en_narrative: She studied up to tenth standard at the girls' high school in Irinja Lakuda, walking four kilometres each way.

title: തൃശ്ശൂർ പൂരം
narrative: എല്ലാ വർഷവും അച്ഛൻ കുടമാറ്റം കാണാൻ കൊണ്ടുപോകുമായിരുന്നു. ആനകളുടെ മുകളിൽ നിറമുള്ള കുടകൾ മാറുന്നത് കണ്ട് അവൾ അത്ഭുതപ്പെട്ടു.
en_narrative: Every year her father took her to see the parasol exchange at Thrissur Pooram, the coloured umbrellas changing on top of the elephants.

title: ഗോപാലേട്ടൻ ദുബായിലേക്ക്
narrative: 1975-ൽ ഗോപാലേട്ടൻ ജോലിക്കായി ദുബായിലേക്ക് പോയി. ഇരുപത് കൊല്ലം അദ്ദേഹം അവിടെ, അവളും കുട്ടികളും ഇവിടെ.
en_narrative: In 1975 her husband Gopalan went to Dubai for work and stayed twenty years while she raised the children in Kerala.

title: കാസറ്റ് കത്തുകൾ
narrative: ദുബായിൽ നിന്ന് ഗോപാലേട്ടൻ ശബ്ദം റെക്കോർഡ് ചെയ്ത കാസറ്റുകൾ അയക്കുമായിരുന്നു. കുട്ടികൾ മറുപടിയായി പാട്ടുകൾ റെക്കോർഡ് ചെയ്തു.
en_narrative: Gopalan sent cassettes of his voice from Dubai, and the children recorded songs back to him.

title: തയ്യൽ യൂണിറ്റ്
narrative: 1980-ൽ അവൾ വീട്ടിൽ ഒരു ചെറിയ തയ്യൽ യൂണിറ്റ് തുടങ്ങി, നാല് സ്ത്രീകൾക്ക് ജോലി കൊടുത്തു. സ്കൂൾ യൂണിഫോമുകളായിരുന്നു പ്രധാന ഓർഡർ.
en_narrative: In 1980 she started a small tailoring unit at home that employed four women, mostly stitching school uniforms.

title: അമ്മമ്മയും സർപ്പക്കാവും
narrative: അമ്മമ്മ എല്ലാ സന്ധ്യക്കും തറവാട്ടിലെ സർപ്പക്കാവിൽ വിളക്ക് വെക്കുമായിരുന്നു. നാഗങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള കഥകൾ പറഞ്ഞു തന്നു.
en_narrative: Her grandmother lit a lamp at the family snake grove every evening and told her stories of the serpent gods.

title: അനിതയുടെ കല്യാണം
narrative: 1990-ൽ മകൾ അനിതയുടെ കല്യാണം തൃശ്ശൂർ ടൗൺ ഹാളിൽ നടന്നു. ഗോപാലേട്ടൻ ദുബായിൽ നിന്ന് രണ്ടാഴ്ചത്തെ ലീവിൽ വന്നു.
en_narrative: Her daughter Anitha married in 1990 at the Thrissur town hall; Gopalan flew in from Dubai on two weeks' leave.

title: 2018-ലെ വെള്ളപ്പൊക്കം
narrative: 2018-ലെ വെള്ളപ്പൊക്കത്തിൽ വീട്ടിൽ നെഞ്ചോളം വെള്ളം കയറി. മത്സ്യത്തൊഴിലാളികളുടെ വള്ളത്തിലാണ് അവരെ രക്ഷിച്ചത്.
en_narrative: In the 2018 Kerala floods water rose chest-high in the house, and fishermen rescued them in their boat.

title: ഓണപ്പൂക്കളം
narrative: ഓണത്തിന് പത്ത് ദിവസവും മുറ്റത്ത് പൂക്കളം ഇടും. തുമ്പ പ്പൂവും ചെ ത്തിയും പറിക്കാൻ കുട്ടികൾ നേരത്തെ എഴുന്നേൽക്കും.
en_narrative: For all ten days of Onam she laid a pookalam in the yard; the children rose early to pick thumba and che thi flowers.

title: എല്ലാ മാസവും കുറച്ച് മാറ്റിവെക്കണം
narrative: എല്ലാ മാസവും കുറച്ച് മാറ്റിവെക്കണം എന്നാണ് അവൾ പേരക്കുട്ടികളോട് പറയുന്നത്. ഗൾഫ് കാശ് എന്നും വരില്ല എന്ന് അവൾ പഠിച്ചു.
en_narrative: She tells her grandchildren to put a little aside every month; she learned that Gulf money does not last forever.

title: ഗോപാലേട്ടൻ തിരിച്ചു വന്നു
narrative: 1995-ൽ ഗോപാലേട്ടൻ ദുബായിൽ നിന്ന് എന്നെന്നേക്കുമായി തിരിച്ചു വന്നു. ഇരുപത് കൊല്ലത്തിനു ശേഷം ഒരുമിച്ച് ജീവിക്കാൻ ആദ്യം ബുദ്ധിമുട്ടായിരുന്നു.
en_narrative: Gopalan returned from Dubai for good in 1995, and after twenty years apart, living together again was hard at first.

title: രാജേഷും പേരക്കുട്ടിയും
narrative: മകൻ രാജേഷ് ബാംഗ്ലൂരിൽ സോഫ്റ്റ്‌വെയർ എഞ്ചിനീയർ ആണ്. പേരക്കുട്ടി മലയാളം കുറച്ചേ സംസാരിക്കൂ.
en_narrative: Her son Rajesh is a software engineer in Bangalore, and her grandson speaks only a little Malayalam.

title: അറുപതാം വയസ്സിൽ ഇംഗ്ലീഷ് പത്രം
narrative: അറുപത് വയസ്സിൽ അവൾ പേരക്കുട്ടിയുടെ സഹായത്തോടെ ഇംഗ്ലീഷ് പത്രം വായിക്കാൻ പഠിച്ചു.
en_title: Reading the English paper at sixty
en_narrative: At sixty she learned to read the English newspaper with her granddaughter's help.

title: കഥകളി
narrative: ഇപ്പോഴും ടിവിയിൽ കഥകളി വരുമ്പോൾ അവൾ മുഴുവൻ കാണും. കുട്ടിക്കാലത്ത് അമ്പലത്തിൽ രാത്രി മുഴുവൻ കഥകളി കണ്ടിട്ടുണ്ട്.
en_narrative: She still watches Kathakali whenever it is on TV; as a child she watched all-night performances at the temple.

title: Sugarcane farm near Mandya
narrative: His father grew sugarcane on a small farm near Mandya. At harvest Prakash rode the bullock cart to the jaggery unit and was allowed to taste the hot jaggery.
en_narrative: His father grew sugarcane on a small farm near Mandya. At harvest Prakash rode the bullock cart to the jaggery unit and was allowed to taste the hot jaggery.

title: Engineering college days
narrative: He studied civil engineering at NIE Mysore from 1968 to 1972, living in the hostel and cycling six kilometres to the workshops. He was the first engineer in the family.
en_narrative: He studied civil engineering at NIE Mysore from 1968 to 1972, living in the hostel and cycling six kilometres to the workshops. He was the first engineer in the family.

title: Grandfather the shanbhog
narrative: His grandfather was the village shanbhog, the accountant who kept land records on palm-leaf and later in thick ledgers. Farmers came to their verandah to settle disputes.
en_narrative: His grandfather was the village shanbhog, the accountant who kept land records on palm-leaf and later in thick ledgers. Farmers came to their verandah to settle disputes.

title: Joining the Railways
narrative: He cleared the engineering services exam and joined Indian Railways in 1974 as an assistant engineer. His first posting was Allahabad, a city he had never seen.
verbatim_quote: I had never been north of Hyderabad
en_narrative: He cleared the engineering services exam and joined Indian Railways in 1974 as an assistant engineer. His first posting was Allahabad, a city he had never seen.

title: The 1974 strike
narrative: During the 1974 rail way strike led by Jorj Fernandis he was a junior officer and slept at the station for nineteen days. Goods trains stood still in every yard.
open_threads: how the strike ended for his division
en_narrative: During the 1974 rail way strike led by Jorj Fernandis he was a junior officer and slept at the station for nineteen days. Goods trains stood still in every yard.

title: A cousin's wedding in Hassan
narrative: He first saw Usha at his cousin's wedding in Hassan in 1976. She sang a devotional song after the muhurtham and he asked his aunt who she was.
verbatim_quote: I asked my aunt who that girl singing was
en_narrative: He first saw Usha at his cousin's wedding in Hassan in 1976. She sang a devotional song after the muhurtham and he asked his aunt who she was.

title: Ramlal ne Hindi sikhayi
narrative: Allahabad mein gangman Ramlal ne unhe Hindi sikhayi. Ramlal kehta tha, 'saab, aap bhi ab Allahabadi ban gaye'.
verbatim_quote: Saab, aap bhi Allahabadi ban gaye
en_narrative: In Allahabad the gangman Ramlal taught him Hindi and used to say he had become a true Allahabadi.

title: Our wedding in Mysore
narrative: He and Usha married in Mysore in 1977. He borrowed a friend's Ambassador car to take her home and it broke down on the way.
verbatim_quote: The car gave up but we didn't
en_narrative: He and Usha married in Mysore in 1977. He borrowed a friend's Ambassador car to take her home and it broke down on the way.

title: The Yashica
narrative: In 1979 he bought a second-hand Yashica camera in Madras with two months of savings. He developed his own prints in a bathroom darkroom.
en_narrative: In 1979 he bought a second-hand Yashica camera in Madras with two months of savings. He developed his own prints in a bathroom darkroom.

title: Madras posting
narrative: 1979 to 1989 Madras Egmore-la posting. Canteen anna kitta Tamil kathukitten, 'saar, neenga ippo namma aalu' nu sollvaaru.
en_narrative: From 1979 to 1989 he was posted at Egmore in Madras and learned Tamil from the canteen man, who said he was now one of them.

title: 1983 final in the colony
narrative: The whole railway colony crowded into the one house with a television to watch the 1983 World Cup final. When the last wicket fell people ran out banging plates.
en_narrative: The whole railway colony crowded into the one house with a television to watch the 1983 World Cup final. When the last wicket fell people ran out banging plates.

title: Divya and Kiran
narrative: His daughter Divya was born in 1979 and his son Kiran in 1982, both in the railway hospital at Perambur.
en_narrative: His daughter Divya was born in 1979 and his son Kiran in 1982, both in the railway hospital at Perambur.

title: Marina Sunday photos
narrative: Every Sunday Mareena beach-ku camera eduthuttu poven, fishermen-a photo edupen. Andha photos innum oru petti-la irukku.
en_narrative: Every Sunday he took his camera to Mareena beach and photographed the fishermen; the prints are still in a box.

title: The bridge near Villupuram
narrative: He supervised a bridge construction near Villupuram. A flash flood washed away the scaffolding a week before completion and they rebuilt it in a month.
en_narrative: He supervised a bridge construction near Villupuram. A flash flood washed away the scaffolding a week before completion and they rebuilt it in a month.

title: इलाहाबाद का पहला क्वार्टर
narrative: इलाहाबाद में रेलवे का पहला क्वार्टर मिला, दो कमरे और बड़ा बरामदा। सर्दियों में अंगीठी जलाना वहीं सीखा।
en_narrative: In Allahabad he got his first railway quarters, two rooms and a big verandah, where he learned to light a coal stove in winter.

title: When no one is watching
narrative: His rule from the Railways: do the job properly even when no one is checking. A bridge does not care who inspected it.
verbatim_quote: A bridge does not care who inspected it
en_narrative: His rule from the Railways: do the job properly even when no one is checking. A bridge does not care who inspected it.

title: October 1984 train
narrative: 1984 mein Delhi ja rahe the jab Indira ji ki khabar aayi; train Jhansi par ruk gayi. Do din station par rahe, bahut dar ka mahaul tha.
en_narrative: He was travelling to Delhi in 1984 when news of Indira Gandhi came; the train stopped at Jhansi and they spent two fearful days at the station.

title: Mother's illness
narrative: When his mother fell ill in 1988 he asked for a transfer to Bangalore to be closer. She lived another six years.
en_narrative: When his mother fell ill in 1988 he asked for a transfer to Bangalore to be closer. She lived another six years.

title: Divisional engineer in Bangalore
narrative: He moved to Bangalore in 1989 as divisional engineer. The city was still green and he cycled to the office on some days.
en_narrative: He moved to Bangalore in 1989 as divisional engineer. The city was still green and he cycled to the office on some days.

title: Kudremukh treks
narrative: With railway colleagues he trekked in the Western Ghats, Kudremukh being his favourite. They carried a stove and made upma at the summit.
en_narrative: With railway colleagues he trekked in the Western Ghats, Kudremukh being his favourite. They carried a stove and made upma at the summit.

title: Divya's sports day
narrative: Madras-la Divya convent school-la padichaa. Sports day-la naan photo eduthen, aval 100 metres-la first vandhaa.
en_narrative: In Madras Divya studied at a convent school; he photographed her sports day when she came first in the 100 metres.

title: 1991 and the private sector
narrative: After 1991 several of his colleagues left for private companies for double the salary. He stayed, and still thinks it was right.
en_narrative: After 1991 several of his colleagues left for private companies for double the salary. He stayed, and still thinks it was right.

title: Usha's Sunday bisibele bath
narrative: Usha made bisibele bath every Sunday. Early in the marriage they argued about money, until they agreed she would keep the household accounts.
en_narrative: Usha made bisibele bath every Sunday. Early in the marriage they argued about money, until they agreed she would keep the household accounts.

title: School under the tree
narrative: His first school near Mandiya had classes under a banyan tree. The head masster rang a bell made from an old rail piece.
en_narrative: His first school near Mandiya had classes under a banyan tree. The head masster rang a bell made from an old rail piece.

title: माघ मेले की स्पेशल ट्रेनें
narrative: 1977 के माघ मेले में भारी भीड़ के लिए स्पेशल ट्रेनें चलानी पड़ीं। वे तीन रात सोए नहीं, प्लेटफ़ॉर्म पर ही खाना खाया।
en_title: Special trains for the Magh Mela
en_narrative: For the huge crowds at the 1977 Magh Mela special trains had to run; he did not sleep for three nights and ate on the platform.

title: Divya's wedding
narrative: His daughter Divya married in Bangalore in 2005. He insisted on taking the photographs himself and missed half the ceremony behind the camera.
verbatim_quote: I saw my daughter's wedding through a viewfinder
en_narrative: His daughter Divya married in Bangalore in 2005. He insisted on taking the photographs himself and missed half the ceremony behind the camera.

title: Retirement farewell
narrative: He retired in 2010 and the division gave him a brass model of a steam engine at the farewell.
en_narrative: He retired in 2010 and the division gave him a brass model of a steam engine at the farewell.

title: Jaldi mat karo
narrative: Ramlal se ek baat seekhi: jaldi mat karo, kaam sahi karo. Ye unhone apne bete ko bhi sikhaya.
verbatim_quote: Jaldi mat karo, kaam sahi karo
en_narrative: From Ramlal he learned: don't hurry, do the work right. He taught his son the same.

title: Grandson's kites
narrative: His grandson was born in 2008 and he taught the boy to fly kites from the terrace, just as he had learned in Allahabad.
en_narrative: His grandson was born in 2008 and he taught the boy to fly kites from the terrace, just as he had learned in Allahabad.

title: Photo club after retirement
narrative: After retiring he joined a photo graphy club and bought a Kenon digital camera. He prints one photo a week for the club wall.
en_narrative: After retiring he joined a photo graphy club and bought a Kenon digital camera. He prints one photo a week for the club wall.

title: Tsunami relief train
narrative: 2004 tsunami appo Chennai-ku relief train-la poi colleague family-ya paathen. Beach pakkam ellame poyiduchu.
en_narrative: After the 2004 tsunami he went to Chennai on a relief train to see a colleague's family; everything near the beach was gone.

title: Dasara elephants
narrative: Every Dasara his father took him to Mysore to see the elephant procession. He remembers sitting on a wall eating groundnuts.
en_narrative: Every Dasara his father took him to Mysore to see the elephant procession. He remembers sitting on a wall eating groundnuts.

title: A partnership
narrative: He believes a marriage is a partnership: he and Usha made every big decision together, even the transfer to Bangalore.
en_narrative: He believes a marriage is a partnership: he and Usha made every big decision together, even the transfer to Bangalore.

title: Shimla toy train
narrative: 2002 mein anniversary par Usha ke saath Shimla gaye, toy train se. Usha ne kaha ab railway wale ki biwi hone ka fayda mila.
en_narrative: For their anniversary in 2002 he and Usha went to Shimla on the toy train; Usha joked she finally got the benefit of a railwayman's wife.

title: रफ़ी के गाने
narrative: उन्हें पुराने फ़िल्मी गानों का शौक़ है, ख़ासकर रफ़ी के। रेडियो पर विविध भारती रोज़ सुनते हैं।
en_narrative: He loves old film songs, especially Rafi's, and listens to Vividh Bharati on the radio every day.

title: Siblings' reunion
narrative: In 2025 all five siblings met at the old farm near Mandya for the first time in twenty years.
en_narrative: In 2025 all five siblings met at the old farm near Mandya for the first time in twenty years.

title: Kiran ki shaadi
narrative: 2012 mein bete Kiran ki shaadi Pune mein hui, Marathi ladki se. Is baar photo kisi aur ne kheenchi.
en_narrative: His son Kiran married a Marathi girl in Pune in 2012; this time someone else took the photographs.

title: Pudhu station opening
narrative: 1986-la Tambaram pakkathula pudhu station open panninom, minister vandhaaru, naan ribbon pidichen.
en_narrative: In 1986 he helped open a new station near Tambaram; a minister came and he held the ribbon.

title: Colony chess club
narrative: Madras railway colony chess club-la Sunday Sunday aaduvom, naan oru thadavai colony champion.
en_narrative: In Madras he played every Sunday at the railway colony chess club and was colony champion once.

title: Pehli train yatra
narrative: Bachpan mein pehli baar Mysore se Bangalore train mein gaya, poore raste khidki se sir bahar.
verbatim_quote: Aankh mein koyla gaya phir bhi
en_narrative: As a boy he took his first train from Mysore to Bangalore with his head out of the window the whole way.

title: नीम वाला आँगन
narrative: इलाहाबाद में सिविल लाइंस के पास उनका घर था, आँगन में बड़ा नीम का पेड़। गर्मियों में पूरा परिवार छत पर खाट डालकर सोता था।
verbatim_quote: रात को तारे गिनते-गिनते सो जाते थे
en_narrative: Her childhood home in Allahabad near Civil Lines had a big neem tree in the courtyard, and in summer the family slept on cots on the roof.

title: वकील पिताजी
narrative: पिताजी इलाहाबाद हाईकोर्ट में वकील थे, हमेशा काला कोट पहनते थे। शाम को वे उर्दू शायरी पढ़कर सुनाते थे।
en_narrative: Her father was a lawyer at the Allahabad High Court who always wore a black coat and read Urdu poetry aloud in the evenings.

title: आँगन की होली
narrative: होली पर आँगन में रंग की बाल्टियाँ भरी जातीं और माँ दो दिन पहले से गुझिया बनातीं। भाई विनोद सबसे पहले पिताजी पर रंग डालता था।
en_narrative: At Holi buckets of colour filled the courtyard and her mother made gujiya two days ahead; her brother Vinod always coloured their father first.

title: मेरी शादी
narrative: 1964 में इलाहाबाद में शान्ति की शादी राम प्रकाश शर्मा से हुई। जयमाला के समय उन्होंने पहली बार उन्हें ठीक से देखा; बारात घोड़ी पर आई और उस रात बारिश हो गई।
verbatim_quote: जयमाला पर ही पहली बार नज़र मिली
en_narrative: Shanti married Ram Prakash Sharma in 1964 in Allahabad. She first saw him properly at the jaimala; the groom came on a mare and it rained that night.

title: कुंब का मेला
narrative: पिताजी ने 1954 के कुंब मेले की भगदड़ की बात बताई थी, उसके बाद परिवार कई साल सन गम नहीं गया। शान्ति को भीड़ से डर तभी से है।
en_narrative: Her father told her about the stampede at the 1954 Kumbh, after which the family stayed away from the San gam for years; she has feared crowds ever since.

title: University ke din
narrative: 1963 mein Allahabad University se B.A. kiya, family ki pehli ladki thi jo graduate hui. Hindi literature padha, aur ek baar Mahadevi Verma ji ko dekha bhi tha.
verbatim_quote: Ghar mein pehli graduate main thi
open_threads: Mahadevi ji se kya baat hui
en_narrative: She took her B.A. from Allahabad University in 1963, the first girl in the family to graduate, studied Hindi literature and once saw Mahadevi Verma.

title: पहली नौकरी
narrative: 1966 में लखनऊ के एक कन्या इंटर कॉलेज में हिंदी की अध्यापिका बनीं। पहली तनख्वाह डेढ़ सौ रुपये थी, जो उन्होंने सास के हाथ में रख दी।
verbatim_quote: पहली तनख्वाह सास के हाथ में रखी
open_threads: पहले दिन कक्षा में क्या हुआ
en_narrative: In 1966 she became a Hindi teacher at a girls' inter college in Lucknow; her first salary of 150 rupees went into her mother-in-law's hands.

title: Sasural Aminabad mein
narrative: Shaadi ke baad Lucknow aa gayi, Aminabad mein joint family thi, bees log ek ghar mein. Shuru mein bahut ajeeb laga, ghoonghat mein rehna padta tha.
en_narrative: After the wedding she moved to a joint family of twenty in Aminabad, Lucknow. It felt strange at first and she had to keep her face veiled.

title: सख़्त सास
narrative: सास बहुत सख़्त थीं, पर उन्होंने ही उन्हें खाना बनाना सिखाया। बाद में दोनों में गहरा प्रेम हो गया।
en_narrative: Her mother-in-law was strict but taught her to cook, and later the two grew very close.

title: चीन युद्ध और सोने की चूड़ियाँ
narrative: 1962 के युद्ध के समय मोहल्ले की औरतों ने ऊनी स्वेटर बुने और शान्ति ने अपनी दो सोने की चूड़ियाँ रक्षा कोष में दे दीं।
en_narrative: During the 1962 war the women of the lane knitted sweaters and Shanti gave two of her gold bangles to the defence fund.

title: चिकनकारी
narrative: लखनऊ में पड़ोसन ज़रीना बी से चिकनकारी सीखी। बेटी के दहेज के लिए उन्होंने खुद छह कुर्ते काढ़े।
en_narrative: She learned chikankari embroidery from her neighbour Zarina Bi in Lucknow and stitched six kurtas herself for her daughter's trousseau.

title: Vice principal
narrative: 1985 mein principal ne unhe vice prinsipal bana diya. Ameenabad se college tak roz rickshaw mein jaati thi.
en_narrative: In 1985 the principal made her vice prinsipal; she went by rickshaw every day from Ameenabad to the college.

title: Amit and Neha
narrative: Her son Amit was born in 1967 and her daughter Neha in 1969. She went back to teaching six weeks after each birth because her mother-in-law looked after the babies.
en_narrative: Her son Amit was born in 1967 and her daughter Neha in 1969. She went back to teaching six weeks after each birth because her mother-in-law looked after the babies.

title: Emergency aur nasbandi
narrative: Emergency ke time husband headmaster the, upar se nasbandi camp ke target aate the. Ghar mein sab dare hue the, baat bhi dheere karte the.
open_threads: unke school par kya asar hua
en_narrative: During the Emergency her husband was a headmaster and had sterilisation camp targets pushed on him; the household lived in fear and spoke in whispers.

title: सब्र
narrative: जीवन ने उन्हें सिखाया कि सब्र सबसे बड़ी ताक़त है। जल्दबाज़ी में लिया फ़ैसला अक्सर पछतावा देता है।
verbatim_quote: सब्र का फल मीठा होता है
en_narrative: Life taught her that patience is the greatest strength and that hasty decisions bring regret.

title: Sankranti ki patang
narrative: Makar Sankranti par bhai Vinod ke saath chhat par patang udaati thi. Vinod manjha khud banata tha aur hamesha patang kaat deta tha.
en_narrative: On Makar Sankranti she flew kites on the roof with her brother Vinod, who made his own manjha and always cut her kite.

title: आईएएस बनी छात्रा
narrative: उनकी एक छात्रा आईएएस अफ़सर बनी और सालों बाद घर आकर उनके पैर छुए। उस दिन उन्हें लगा कि पढ़ाना सफल हुआ।
en_title: The student who became an IAS officer
en_narrative: One of her students became an IAS officer and years later came home to touch her feet; that day she felt her teaching had succeeded.

title: Mangalvaar ka kirtan
narrative: Har Mangalvaar mohalle ke mandir mein kirtan hota tha, wo bhajan gaati thi. Dholak Sharma ji ki bhabhi bajaati thi.
en_narrative: Every Tuesday there was kirtan at the neighbourhood temple where she sang bhajans.

title: ट्रेनिंग कैंप से चिट्ठी
narrative: पति कविता के शौक़ीन थे। ट्रेनिंग कैंप से उन्होंने एक लंबी चिट्ठी लिखी जिसमें निराला की कविता थी; वह चिट्ठी आज भी संदूक में है।
en_narrative: Her husband loved poetry and wrote her a long letter from training camp with a Nirala poem in it; she still keeps it in a trunk.

title: Curfew in Lucknow
narrative: In December 1992 there was a curfew in Lucknow and the schools shut for weeks. Neighbours of every community shared milk and vegetables across the walls.
en_narrative: In December 1992 there was a curfew in Lucknow and the schools shut for weeks. Neighbours of every community shared milk and vegetables across the walls.

title: Neha ki shaadi
narrative: 1990 mein beti Neha ki shaadi Lucknow mein ki. Saara intezaam unhone khud kiya; halwai ki cheeni khatam ho gayi aur raat ko bazaar bhejna pada.
verbatim_quote: Beti ki vidaai par main khadi nahi reh paayi
en_narrative: Her daughter Neha married in Lucknow in 1990. Shanti made all the arrangements; the sweet-maker ran out of sugar and someone had to be sent to the market at night.

title: दादीमा की ज़मींदारी कहानियाँ
narrative: दादीमा प्रतापगड़ के पास गाँव से थीं और ज़मींदारी के दिनों की कहानियाँ सुनाती थीं। हाथी वाली कहानी शान्ति को सबसे ज़्यादा याद है।
en_narrative: Her grandmother came from a village near Pratapgad and told stories of the zamindari days; the elephant story is the one she remembers best.

title: विदाई समारोह
narrative: 2005 में सेवानिवृत्ति पर कॉलेज ने विदाई समारोह किया। छात्राओं ने उनका लिखा एक गीत गाया।
en_narrative: When she retired in 2005 the college held a farewell and the students sang a song she had written.

title: Ramayan on Doordarshan
narrative: In 1987 they had the only TV in the lane, so every Sunday morning the whole mohalla sat on their floor to watch Ramayan. She made tea for thirty people.
en_narrative: In 1987 they had the only TV in the lane, so every Sunday morning the whole mohalla sat on their floor to watch Ramayan. She made tea for thirty people.

title: Padhai mat chhodna
narrative: Poti ko hamesha kehti hai: padhai kabhi mat chhodna, beta. Aurat ke liye wahi asli zevar hai.
en_narrative: She always tells her granddaughter never to give up her studies, because for a woman that is the real jewellery.

title: संगम पर स्नान
narrative: मकर संक्रांति की सुबह पिताजी उन्हें अंधेरे में संगम ले जाते। ठंडे पानी में डुबकी के बाद गरम जलेबी मिलती थी।
en_narrative: On Makar Sankranti mornings her father took her to the Sangam in the dark, and after the cold dip there were hot jalebis.

title: पति का जाना
narrative: 2010 में पति का देहांत हो गया। बच्चों ने बुलाया पर वे लखनऊ वाले घर में ही रहीं।
en_narrative: Her husband died in 2010. The children asked her to move, but she stayed on in the Lucknow house.

title: अमरूद और तुलसी
narrative: घर के पीछे छोटा बगीचा है, अम रूद का पेड़ और तुल सी। सर्दियों में अमरूद पड़ोसियों में बाँटती हैं।
en_narrative: Behind the house is a small garden with a gua va tree and tul si; in winter she shares the guavas with the neighbours.

title: Saaksharta class
narrative: Retirement ke baad 2006 se 2012 tak ek NGO ke saath auraton ko padhna-likhna sikhaya. Ek 60 saal ki amma ne pehli baar apna naam likha.
verbatim_quote: Usne apna naam likha aur ro padi
en_narrative: After retiring she taught women to read and write with an NGO from 2006 to 2012; a sixty-year-old woman wrote her own name for the first time.

title: Fortieth anniversary
narrative: For their fortieth anniversary in 2004 the children threw a party at home. Her husband recited a poem he had written for her.
en_narrative: For their fortieth anniversary in 2004 the children threw a party at home. Her husband recited a poem he had written for her.

title: भगवती बहनजी
narrative: प्राइमरी स्कूल में भगवती बहनजी तख़्ती पर लिखना सिखाती थीं और ग़लती पर रूल से मारती थीं। फिर भी उन्हीं की वजह से लिखावट सुंदर है।
en_narrative: In primary school Bhagwati behenji taught writing on a wooden slate and rapped knuckles with a ruler, yet her handwriting is beautiful because of her.

title: आनंद भवन में नेहरू जी
narrative: बचपन में पिताजी उन्हें आनंद भवन ले गए जहाँ नेहरू जी को दूर से देखा। उन्होंने बच्चों की तरफ़ गुलाब फेंका था।
en_narrative: As a child her father took her to Anand Bhawan, where she saw Nehru from a distance throwing a rose towards the children.

title: Sunday video call
narrative: Har Sunday Bangalore se Amit ke bachche video call karte hain. Unhe Hindi kam aati hai, to wo unhe kahaniyan sunaati hai.
en_narrative: Every Sunday Amit's children call from Bangalore; they speak little Hindi, so she tells them stories.

title: रिश्तों में झुकना
narrative: उनका मानना है कि रिश्ते निभाने के लिए कभी-कभी झुकना पड़ता है। अहं से घर नहीं चलते।
en_narrative: She believes relationships sometimes need you to bend, and that ego does not keep a home together.

title: Paper boats in the gali
narrative: In the Allahbad monsoon the ga li outside flooded and the children floated paper boats. Her mother scolded her for tearing up her brother's notebook.
en_narrative: In the Allahbad monsoon the ga li outside flooded and the children floated paper boats. Her mother scolded her for tearing up her brother's notebook.

title: प्रेमचंद की ईदगाह
narrative: उन्हें प्रेमचंद की कहानियाँ पढ़ना पसंद है; ईदगाह सबसे प्रिय है। हामिद का चिमटा याद करके आज भी आँखें भर आती हैं।
en_narrative: She loves Premchand's stories, Idgah most of all; remembering Hamid's tongs still brings tears.

title: Amit ki shaadi
narrative: 1996 mein bete Amit ki shaadi Bangalore mein hui, bahu Kannada thi. Wahan ka khana bilkul samajh nahi aaya.
en_narrative: Her son Amit married a Kannada bride in Bangalore in 1996, and she could make nothing of the food there.

title: Neha ki pehli Holi sasural mein
narrative: Shaadi ke baad Neha ki pehli Holi sasural mein thi, main gujiya ka dabba lekar Kanpur gayi.
en_title: Neha's first Holi with her in-laws
en_narrative: After her wedding Neha spent her first Holi with her in-laws, and Shanti took a box of gujiya to Kanpur.

title: Vinod ki naukri
narrative: Bhai Vinod ko 1968 mein railway mein naukri mili, poore mohalle mein laddoo baante.
en_narrative: Her brother Vinod got a railway job in 1968 and the family handed out laddoos to the whole lane.

title: Dussehra ka mela
narrative: Bachpan mein Dussehra par Ravan dahan dekhne pitaji ke kandhe par baith kar jaati thi.
en_narrative: As a child she watched Ravan being burnt at Dussehra from her father's shoulders.
